scope: Single-owner image, clip, and video-edit projects; conversations, history, uploads, Sketch, exports, and read-only shares.

defaultTransition.message: This action is not available in the current state.
defaultTransition.surface: For user commands show the reason. For inapplicable stale/system events preserve state and log; known duplicates use explicit no-op rules.

unknownEvent.message: Unsupported action; do not infer a transition.

externalGuards: Explicit input roles and context branch
Confirmed provider outcome rather than browser timeout
Durability and attachment before deliverable aggregation

invariants.I03: Transport retry cannot duplicate a request or charge
invariants.I04: Output slot identity and sources are exact
invariants.I05: Draft persistence is independent of jobs
invariants.I10: States have defined actions or wait reasons
invariants.I11: Inputs and exports pin immutable versions
invariants.I13: Authorization is checked at every boundary
invariants.I14: Customer usage differs from provider expense

states.local: New work exists only on this device; generation is unavailable.
states.creating: An idempotent project-creation request is being reconciled.
states.ready: The owner can work in this project.
states.load_failed: Project loading failed; retry the same identity.
states.inaccessible: Authorization is missing; cached private content is hidden.
states.trashing: Trash is requested; new work is blocked while the server decides.
states.trashed: Project and work are retained but read-only; public links are denied.

states.active: Requests and drafts can be added.
states.archiving: Archive write is pending; local draft is retained.
states.archived: History is readable; new submissions require restore.

states.online: Protected reads/writes can be attempted subject to authorization.
states.offline: Only cached reading and local editing are available.
states.reconnecting: Reconcile saved writes, receipts and jobs before enabling new dispatch.

states.guest: Anonymous text draft only; protected work requires sign-in.
states.signed_in: The current authenticated owner can access their work.
states.reauth_required: Protected operations paused; same-owner local work retained.
states.signed_out: Private content hidden and owner-scoped local drafts locked.

states.open: Editable, with readiness and saving tracked separately.
states.parked: Retained unfinished work outside the current composer.
states.submitted: Frozen revision belongs to an accepted request.
states.discarded: Explicitly discarded draft; submitted history is unaffected.

states.local: Newest revision is locally checkpointed, not server-acknowledged.
states.saving: Saving a captured revision; newer edits may exist.
states.saved: The current revision is acknowledged by the server.
states.failed: Server save failed; the local revision remains recoverable.
states.conflict: Both server and local revisions are retained; submit blocked.
states.local_failed: Local checkpoint failed; leaving requires export or explicit discard.

states.none: No media target; only actions not requiring media may submit.
states.version: One explicitly bound, available version or validated input set.
states.pending: This draft explicitly waits for one named request slot.
states.choice_required: An output, primary input or context change must be chosen explicitly before submission.
states.unavailable: Bound source is failed, lost, unlinked or unauthorized.

states.idle: No request envelope is in transit for this draft revision.
states.sending: Frozen envelope and submission identity are stored and being sent.
states.unknown: Acceptance is unknown; reconcile this exact identity.
states.accepted: Authoritative receipt recovered; accepted request is immutable.
states.rejected: Authoritative pre-acceptance rejection; original draft retained.
states.needs_attention: Acceptance deadline expired without authoritative outcome; frozen envelope retained for manual reconciliation.

states.queued: Accepted and queued; no outcome assumed.
states.running: At least one required output slot is executing.
states.settling: Execution produced outputs; saving/linking or remaining slots are unresolved.
states.succeeded: All required output slots are durable and deliverable.
states.partial: At least one deliverable slot; remaining slots are terminal failures/cancellations.
states.failed: No deliverable slots and all slots definitively failed/lost.
states.cancelled: All required slots cancelled before producing a deliverable.
states.needs_attention: Automatic recovery expired; evidence retained and unsettled usage released. Manual status/storage recovery remains available.

states.waiting: Stable slot accepted; no provider dispatch yet.
states.unknown: Provider outcome cannot yet be established.
states.received: Provider output exists; durable copy still required.
states.saving: Copying or validating the same output into owned storage.
states.save_failed: Output existed; retry storing that same output.
states.stored: Durable output version exists; attachment is tracked separately.
states.failed: Definitive provider failure, without usable output.
states.output_lost: Provider output cannot be recovered into durable storage.
states.cancelled: Cancellation confirmed without a delivered output.

states.pending: Owned durable output still needs a project association.
states.attached: Original output is linked to its recorded project.
states.failed: Association failed; repair reuses media and identity.
states.destination_missing: The recorded destination is unavailable or trashed; retain recovery ownership.
states.recovery_attached: Durable output is linked to the owner recovery inbox; original project target remains recorded.

states.none: No cancellation intent has been recorded.
states.requested: Cancellation requested; completion and charges remain possible.
states.unable: Cancellation could not stop the work; its outcome remains tracked.
states.reconciling: Late or contradictory output requires reconciliation.

states.staged: File and intended input role selected locally.
states.uploading: Upload in progress using one import identity.
states.verifying: Server validates content and durable ownership.
states.ready: Owned file is available as an input.
states.rejected: File is incompatible or invalid; choose/fix a file.
states.missing_bytes: Local file bytes unavailable after reload.
states.cancelled: Draft upload was cancelled; no late reattachment.

states.unloaded: Version has not been requested by the viewer.
states.ready: The named version is accessible; decoding may be separate.
states.refreshing: Refreshing an expired URL for the same version.
states.unavailable: Media cannot currently be retrieved; history remains.
states.denied: Owner/access check failed; no alternate URL bypass.

states.stopped: No playback; selected clip starts at zero unless restoring fullscreen.
states.paused: Selected clip paused at its current time.
states.buffering: Selected clip is waiting for media data.
states.error: Playback/decode failed; generation status is unchanged.

states.off: No live preview dispatch; accepted images remain in project history.
states.connecting: Starting the bounded live preview session.
states.live: Live preview input can dispatch within its allowance.
states.paused: Drawing and last output retained; no further dispatch.
states.error: Preview failed; retain the last successful displayed output.
states.limit_reached: Allowance prevents additional frames until reset.

states.empty: No positive-duration content yet; editing allowed, export unavailable.
states.valid: All current edit inputs/settings/timing pass validation.
states.invalid: Saved editable work has identified source/timing/format conflicts.

states.private: No public link exists for this immutable version.
states.published: Confirmed active link points to one immutable version.
states.revoking: Revocation requested; do not claim it is already complete.
states.revoked: Link permanently denied; a future publication requires a new link.

states.not_required: Free mode; customer billing absent, provider expense still recorded.
states.quoted: Current quote matches the reviewed request and expiry.
states.quote_invalid: Quote expired/changed or request changed; submit blocked.
states.reserving: Atomic acceptance and usage reservation in progress.
states.reserved: Accepted maximum held; no duplicate reservation allowed.
states.settled: Successful delivered slots settled once under the accepted policy.
states.released: Unused/failed slots released or refunded without erasing provider expense.

states.waiting: Persisted question targets an exact draft revision; answer required.
states.answering: Answer submission is being saved under that question identity.
states.proposal_ready: Answer saved and proposal based on the same current draft revision.
states.stale_proposal: Target changed or became noneditable; retain proposal and require an authorized writable new draft or explicit resolution.
states.applied: Proposal explicitly applied; no media dispatched.
states.dismissed: Question/proposal closed; required missing information still blocks submission.

states.resolving: Resolving an authorized URL for this stored version.
states.started: Browser file transfer has started; no claim about writing to disk.
states.failed: Resolve/transfer failed; original file/job remain intact.

states.streaming: Provisional text is arriving for a captured request/context.
states.interrupted: Text stream stopped; reconcile the same request.
states.saved: Final response/proposal is durable and available for explicit Apply.
states.failed: Text request definitively failed; user can deliberately request again.

readiness.evaluation: derived for the current draft; never persisted as project stage

reusedModels.export: submission + request + output_slot + attachment + cancellation + usage, with a captured video-edit revision (E04/E05)
reusedModels.image_or_video_generation: submission + request + output_slot + attachment + cancellation + usage
reusedModels.sketch_acceptance: submission + output_slot(received/saving/stored) + attachment; no provider regeneration or customer charge (M07/M09)
reusedModels.video_edit_save: video_edit + draft_save, each with its own edit-revision identity (E01/D08)

instanceIdentity: Every submission consumes its own execution draft; contextual draft/editor/media IDs are inputs, never substituted as submission uniqueness keys (H12).
